---
title: "Max wins best paper award L4DC 2025"
date: 2025-06-01
description: "Max and collaborators Will Compton and Aaron Ames receive best paper award."
---

Our paper on learning for layered safety-critical control architectures, led by Will Compton, was awarded the best paper award the 2025 Conference on Learning for Dynamics and Control. [Check out the paper](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v283/compton25a.html) for more details.
